messages.「予知眼」で攻撃を読み、それが尽きると強化技「処分」で火傷と振動を叩き込む親指の: A Thumb master that reads attacks with The Eye of Precognition, then unleashes enhanced Disposal for Burn and Tremor when it runs out.
messages.予知眼: 登場時に30。マッチ1回ごとや「予知」発動時に減る。予知眼があると、一: **The Eye of Precognition**: 30 when she appears. It decreases with each Clash and when Precognition triggers. While she has it, taking a one-sided attack or Unbreakable Coin attack, or losing a Clash, triggers the Evade skill Precognition (once per turn). At 0, it turns into Eye of Precognition - Overheat (+3 Offense Level, −3 Defense Level).
messages.加速弾: 特殊弾丸。S2・S3のコインで消耗し、消耗1につき呼吸2・呼吸回数2を: **Acceleration Round**: Special ammo. Spent by S2 and S3 Coins, granting 2 Poise and 2 Poise Count per round. Her Defense skill loads up to 5 Acceleration Rounds at Turn End. If she has no Acceleration Rounds at Turn Start, S2 becomes Sezionatura di Cervo (with all-Unbreakable Coins and +2 Final Power during Overheat).
messages.「処分」: 予知眼が過熱に変わったターンの終了時に再装填し(戦闘ごとに1回)、次: **Disposal**: She reloads at the end of the turn her Eye of Precognition turns into Overheat (once per battle), and on the next turn one basic skill becomes Disposal. All 5 Coins are Unbreakable. Defeating an enemy marked as a Game Target adds Disposal on the next turn.
messages.火傷と振動: 各スキルで火傷と振動を付与し、合計に応じて威力が上がる。振動-灼熱: **Burn and Tremor**: Each skill inflicts Burn and Tremor, and power rises with their total. It converts into Tremor - Scorch and triggers Tremor Burst.
messages.序盤は予知眼で攻撃をいなしながら火傷と振動を積み、予知眼が尽きたら、過熱中(ター: Early on, parry attacks with The Eye of Precognition while stacking Burn and Tremor, and once it runs out, attack hard with Disposal during Overheat (which increases by 10 at each Turn Start and returns to The Eye of Precognition at 30). Paired with Heathcliff's The House of Spiders: The Thumb Apprentice, Heathcliff follows up while she has The Eye of Precognition and provides Assist Defense during Overheat. Activate the combat passive La Spada di Palermo (3 Wrath and 2 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ; +1 Coin Power and +25% damage for Skill 3 while she has at least 1 Acceleration Round) before her first Disposal.
